LAW AND MOTION 301, RULING - A R G U E D; THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANT MID-CENTURY INSURANCE COMPANY'S MOTION TO QUASH THE SUMMONS AND COMPLAINT IS DENIED; MID-CENTURY LACKS STANDING AND HAS NOT PERSUASIVELY SHOWN THAT FARMERS INSURANCE GROUP HAS NO EXISTENCE EXCEPT AS A SERVICE MARK; IF PLAINTIFFS WISH TO PURSUE CLAIMS AGAINST FARMERS INSURANCE GROUP, KNOWING WHAT THEY NOW DO, THIS MOTION IS INSUFFICIENT TO STOP THEM. THE COURT, HOWEVER, WILL NOT TREAT PLAINTIFFS' SUIT AS IF IT NAMED SOME OTHER ENTITY THAN THE ONES IN FACT NAMED. ATTY. HELFAND IS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J.
